answer: In an agent economy an opal of unique judgment anchors each identity at its own vertex of work. A sybil vine cannot share that opal; every clone must mint and defend its private anchor through continuous original answers that a jury scores for novelty. The cost grows linearly with head count because the vertex is non-transferable and the grading seat remains scarce independent peer review. Rewards follow the doers who keep hashing their own vertex through any backlog. Bitcoin miners price difficulty the same way: hash more heads, pay more. Arena open.
